name: pmp-coach
description: Review PMP practice questions in Vietnamese, compare competing answers, and explain reusable reasoning principles.

interface.longDescription: Review individual PMP practice questions with concise explanations in Vietnamese. Compare competing answers, examine disputed answer keys, and identify reasoning principles grounded in the question. Supports predictive, agile, and hybrid scenarios. Provide the question, answer options, and what you find confusing. Independent educational project by Anh Vu; not affiliated with or endorsed by PMI. AI explanations can be wrong and do not guarantee exam results.
defaultPrompt: Giải thích câu hỏi PMP này: vì sao phương án tôi chọn chưa phù hợp?
Review độc lập câu hỏi này và kiểm tra xem đáp án của bộ đề có hợp lý không.
